tools.name: get_spot_prices
tools.description: Current and previous-session spot prices for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper and nickel, in any supported currency and per troy ounce or gram.

base.description: A currency code from the live catalog at /api/currencies (ISO 4217 fiat plus BTC and the metal codes). Defaults to USD.

unit.description: Price per troy ounce or per gram. Defaults to troy_oz.

metals.description: Metal symbols to include (xau gold, xag silver, xpt platinum, xpd palladium, xcu copper, ni nickel). Omit for all six; Goldback is not a spot metal.

tools.name: get_observed_premiums
tools.description: Rolling fine-metal-weighted median asking premiums for silver, gold, platinum, palladium, copper, nickel and Goldback, observed from marketplace listings.

metal.description: Which metal's observed premiums to return.

limit.description: Product page size. Without a query, pages browse the most-listed products.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the same tool with exactly the same filters.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily historical series for charting — one metal or the Goldback.

metal.description: The metal (or Goldback) whose history to return.

days.description: How many trailing days of history to return.

base.description: A currency code from the live catalog at /api/currencies (ISO 4217 fiat plus BTC and the metal codes). Defaults to USD.

format.description: ohlc returns open/high/low/close rows; line returns closes.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the same tool with exactly the same filters.

tools.name: get_goldback_rate
tools.description: The latest Goldback premium multiple over its gold content, and the exchange rate that follows from it.

base.description: A currency code from the live catalog at /api/currencies (ISO 4217 fiat plus BTC and the metal codes). Defaults to USD.

tools.name: list_supported_currencies
tools.description: The live list of codes every `currency`/`base` parameter accepts — ISO 4217 fiat plus the metal codes.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match against code or name.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the same tool with exactly the same filters.

tools.name: get_how_to_use
tools.description: StackerScan's How to Use guide in any app language: its table of contents, or one section as markdown quoting the app's own button and field labels. Sections: createAccount (Your Account), stackSettings (Stack Settings), addItems (Adding Items to Your Stack), editItems (Editing, Selling and Deleting Items), addPhotos (Adding Photos to Your Items), managePortfolio (Understanding Your Portfolio Overview), worthToday (How Items Are Valued), dataFields (Understanding Your Item Data Fields), useTags (How to Use Tags), useCredits (Using Credits), trackPrices (Tracking Metal Prices), premiums (Checking Premiums), stackChat (Asking About Your Stack).

locale.description: App language, for the labels a person sees in it. Defaults to en.

section.description: A section id. Omit for the table of contents.
